name: Rhum agricole vieux
description: Aged rhum agricole: rum distilled from fresh-pressed sugarcane juice rather than molasses, then aged in oak. Martinique's AOC rules govern the age tiers (VO, VSOP, XO), and the style is grassy, vegetal and complex — Clément and Neisson are reference producers. It brings an earthy brightness to tiki drinks like the Donga Punch.
